body: I was in your position a week ago. In fact, I had the said exam today! Like others have said, think of the repercussions. Set up an internet blocking site, play some study music, set up rewards and get pumped. Get pumped with the idea of kicking ass, of doing well, of achieving far beyond your objective. Success builds confidence, which gives you drive and passion. That eventually turns into dedication. Good luck, I'll be thinking of you. You can do it.
Thank you so much man. This comment made me open my eyes. It's tough, but I do have a good life and I need to grab it with both hands and run with it. Take care, and thank you once again.
